question: Why does my game lag in Forward Assault Remix, and how can I fix it?
answer: Lag in Forward Assault Remix can be caused by several factors. First, check your internet connection; a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data connection is essential. Second, lower the in-game graphics settings to reduce the load on your device. For example, setting the texture quality to 'Low' can improve performance. Lastly, close background apps to free up RAM. [配置对照表: High graphics = More lag, Low graphics = Smoother gameplay] If the issue persists, consider updating your device's operating system and the game itself.
